description: Pay for, renew, change or cancel a deployed agent's plan, or buy extra credits. An agent has one of three plans, smallest first: Starter, Pro or Max. Each has a fixed monthly price and monthly credits, and every plan includes every skill. Charges come from the Wiro wallet of the agent's workspace (the team wallet for a team agent); the connected project must belong to that same workspace. Every call without confirm: true only returns what will happen and the amount (for a move to a larger plan, the prorated amount Wiro works out, or the most it can charge when that is worked out only at the change). Show it to the user, get their approval, then repeat the call with confirm: true and, for a charge, confirm_charge_usd set to the quoted amount (for a move to a larger plan, quote.maxChargeUsd); if the price changed in between, nothing is charged and a new quote comes back. Never repeat a confirmed charge that failed or timed out without checking get_my_agent first. subscribe starts a plan for an agent without one; renew undoes a cancellation or renews an expired wallet plan; change_plan moves to another plan: a larger plan starts now and charges the prorated difference for the rest of the period, a smaller plan starts with the next renewal and charges or refunds nothing, and asking for the plan the agent is on undoes a move set for the next renewal; buy_credits adds a credit pack, on any plan; cancel stops renewals with no refund. Plans renew every 30 days until cancelled. Renewals, plan changes and packs leave a running agent running. An agent whose plan is billed by card moves to a larger plan and is topped up in the Wiro dashboard, and a personal card plan is cancelled there; the tool returns the link and charges nothing. A personal card plan can move to a smaller plan here: the card pays the smaller plan from the next renewal; a team's card plan changes plans in the dashboard. A card plan that is moving to wallet billing pays change_plan and buy_credits from the wallet, and cancel works once the wallet bills it. A card plan whose last payment did not go through has not ended and takes no new plan: the payment is fixed from Billing in the dashboard, in the personal workspace of the person whose card pays for the plan, and the plan then renews by itself. On a team agent only a team admin, the organization's owner or the person who deployed the agent can pay for it or change its plan; other members are refused and nothing is charged.

action.description: subscribe, change_plan, cancel, renew or buy_credits.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents or deploy_agent.

confirm.description: false returns only the quote. true performs the action. Set it only after the user approved it.

confirm_charge_usd.description: With confirm: true, the amount the user approved, from the quote's nextAction (quote.chargeNowUsd, or quote.maxChargeUsd for a move to a larger plan). Required for every action that charges: subscribe, change_plan to a larger plan, buy_credits and renewing an expired plan. If a fresh quote no longer matches it, nothing is charged and the new quote is returned. For a move to a larger plan it is the most the user agreed to pay now.

pack.description: buy_credits only: the credit pack to buy. Leave it out to get the packs with their credits and prices.

plan.description: subscribe: the plan to pay for (default: the agent's current plan, else starter). change_plan: the plan to move to; leave it out to get the plans with their prices.

request_id.description: buy_credits only: the id returned by the quote. Repeating a purchase with the same id never charges twice. Every new purchase needs a new quote; an id whose purchase already completed buys nothing.

name: manage_agent_billing

monthly.description: The monthly credits this period grants. A plan change inside a period moves it for the time left, so it can differ from renewal.

renewal.description: The monthly credits each renewal grants.

lastActivityAt.description: When the agent's newest message was written, on any channel, scheduled runs included. Left out when it has none.

nextPlan.description: The plan the agent moves to at its next renewal, when a move is set: another plan, or its own plan at today's price. null when none is set; left out when Wiro does not say.

setupRequired.description: Whether the agent waits for setup. list_my_agents goes by the status (6). get_my_agent also checks each required credential and names what is missing.

amountUsd.description: What the plan costs every 30 days. For a plan that has ended, what a new period costs: the price of its plan today.

atPeriodEnd.description: For an active plan, what happens at periodEndsAt: it renews, it ends, or unknown for a card plan whose renewal is managed in the Wiro dashboard.

tier.description: The agent's plan: starter, pro or max.

change.description: change_plan: upgrade (a larger plan, now), downgrade (a smaller plan, from the next renewal) or undo_downgrade (keep the plan, and undo the move set for the next renewal).

creditsNow.description: change_plan to a larger plan: the credits this period gains now. monthlyCredits is what every renewal gives.

plan.description: subscribe and change_plan: the plan this quote is for. renew: the plan it renews on.

startsAt.description: change_plan to a smaller plan: when the period ends; the new plan starts with the renewal after it.

creditsNow.description: change_plan to a larger plan: the credits this period gained with it. monthlyCredits is what every renewal gives.

nextPlan.description: change_plan: the plan set for the next renewal, or null when none is.

title: Manage a Wiro agent's plan and credits
